definitions.eot_total_ms: first turn_end at/after the reference end - 80 ms (before min(end + 6 s, next user onset)) minus the reference end; decision audio time + measured compute
definitions.eot_decision_ms: the audio time at which the deciding input was complete (ours: the frame's decision-ready time on the served ASR clock, which already holds the chunk + lookahead buffering; baselines: the end of the deciding Silero chunk) minus the reference end = eot_total - compute
definitions.false_interruption_pct: % of reference user turns with a turn_end in [start, end - 80 ms)
definitions.missed_pct: % of reference turn ends with no turn_end in [end - 80 ms, min(end + 6 s, next user onset))
